arxiv-2101-01750.title: Quantum manipulation of a two-level mechanical system
arxiv-2101-01750.creator: Salvatore Chiavazzo, Anders S. Sørensen, Oleksandr Kyriienko, Luca Dellantonio
arxiv-2101-01750.description: Abstract We consider a nonlinearly coupled electromechanical system, and develop a quantitative theory for two-phonon cooling. In the presence of two-phonon cooling, the mechanical Hilbert space is effectively reduced to its ground and first excited states, allowing for quantum operations at the level of individual phonons and preparing nonclassical mechanical states with negative Wigner functions.

arxiv-2206-04829.title: Impact of dynamics, entanglement, and Markovian noise on the fidelity of few-qubit digital quantum simulation
arxiv-2206-04829.creator: M. D. Porter \aff 1,2 \corresp and I. Joseph \aff 1
arxiv-2206-04829.description: Abstract Quantum algorithms have been proposed to accelerate the simulation of the chaotic dynamical systems that are ubiquitous in the physics of plasmas. Quantum computers without error correction might even use noise to their advantage to calculate the Lyapunov exponent by measuring the Loschmidt echo fidelity decay rate.

arxiv-2304-09559.title: Resource engines
arxiv-2304-09559.creator: Hanna Wojewódka-Ściążko, Zbigniew Puchała, Kamil Korzekwa
arxiv-2304-09559.description: Abstract In this paper we aim to push the analogy between thermodynamics and quantum resource theories one step further. Previous inspirations were based predominantly on thermodynamic considerations concerning scenarios with a single heat bath, neglecting an important part of thermodynamics that studies heat engines operating between two baths at different temperatures.

arxiv-2401-13590.title: Effects of dilute neutron matter on the neutron star crust equation of state Journal: Eur. Phys. J. A This work was a matter of many discussions with Peter Schuck, who had a deep interest in correlated many-body systems and their application in the understanding of the properties of neutron stars.
arxiv-2401-13590.creator: G. Grams e1,addr1, J. Margueron e2,addr2,addr3
arxiv-2401-13590.description: Abstract We develop a compressible liquid-drop model to describe the crust of neutron stars for which the role of the nuclear clusters, the neutron gas, and the electrons are clearly identified. The novelty relies on the contribution of the neutron gas, which is qualitatively adjusted to reproduce ’ab initio’ predictions in dilute neutron matter.

arxiv-2402-04467.title: DySLIM: Dynamics Stable Learning by Invariant Measure for Chaotic Systems
arxiv-2402-04467.creator: Yair Schiff, Zhong Yi Wan, Jeffrey B. Parker, Stephan Hoyer, Volodymyr Kuleshov, Fei Sha, Leonardo Zepeda-Núñez
arxiv-2402-04467.description: Abstract Learning dynamics from dissipative chaotic systems is notoriously difficult due to their inherent instability, as formalized by their positive Lyapunov exponents, which exponentially amplify errors in the learned dynamics. arxiv-2409-08741.title: Adaptive Sampling for Continuous Group Equivariant Neural Networks
arxiv-2409-08741.creator: Berfin Inal, Gabriele Cesa
arxiv-2409-08741.description: Abstract Steerable networks, which process data with intrinsic symmetries, often use Fourier-based non-linearities that require sampling from the entire group, leading to a need for discretization in continuous groups. As the number of samples increases, both performance and equivariance improve, yet this also leads to higher computational costs.

arxiv-2502-20028.title: Every projective Oka manifold is elliptic
arxiv-2502-20028.creator: Franc Forstnerič and Finnur Lárusson
arxiv-2502-20028.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Franc Forstnerič and Finnur Lárusson. We show that every projective Oka manifold is elliptic in the sense of Gromov. This gives an affirmative answer to a long-standing open question. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification
Primary 32Q56; secondary 32E10

1. Introduction

A complex manifold
Y
is said to be an Oka manifold
if it satisfies all forms of the homotopy principle
(also called Oka principle in this context) for holomorphic maps
X\to Y

from any Stein manifold
X
.

arxiv-2601-16469.title: Beyond the Training Domain: Robust Generative Transition State Models for Unseen Chemistry
arxiv-2601-16469.creator: Samir Darouich, Jacob W. Toney, Weiliang Luo, Johannes Kästner, Mathias Niepert, Heather J. Kulik*
arxiv-2601-16469.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Transition states (TSs) govern the rates and outcomes of chemical reactions, making their accurate prediction a central challenge in computational chemistry. Although recent machine-learning models achieve near chemical accuracy in the prediction of TS structures and the associated reaction barriers for small organic reactions, their ability to generalize beyond the training domain remains largely unexplored.

pmc-11484895.title: Differential spatio-temporal responses of Red Sea coral reef benthic communities to a mass bleaching event
pmc-11484895.creator: Karla Gonzalez, Nauras Daraghmeh, Diego Lozano-Cortés, Francesca Benzoni, Michael L. Berumen, Susana Carvalho
pmc-11484895.description: Understanding how coral reefs respond to disturbances is fundamental to assessing their resistance and resilience, particularly in the context of climate change. Due to the escalating frequency and intensity of coral bleaching events, it is essential to evaluate spatio-temporal responses of coral reef communities to disentangle the mechanisms underlying ecological changes.

pmc-11591007.title: The “Emorality” of Caring: Validation of an Empirical Model of the Moral Feelings of Affective Care in Teaching Communities

pmc-11591007.description: This article presents a study that addresses the challenge of establishing a relationship between the axiological and the affective, by validating a structural model through an assessment instrument (SEMORCUNA) that isolates the moral feelings associated with ‘affective care’. The research sample consisted of 222 teachers, all of whom were either in training or were active professionals in the teaching field.

Eyes were categorised as mild-to-moderate VFD (GI) or severe VFD (GII).

pmc-12581247.creator: Yixin Liu, Yusong Zhang, Peiying Lin, Jie Pan, Mengqi Xu, Xiaozhe Li, Dongxu Liu

pmc-12608865.title: Dual Role of the Spinal Endocannabinoid System in Response to Noxious Stimuli: Antinociceptive Pathways and Neuropathic Pain Mechanisms
pmc-12608865.creator: Raquel Saldaña, Antonio J. Carrascosa, Abraham B. Torregrosa, Francisco Navarrete, María Salud García-Gutiérrez, Jorge Manzanares
pmc-12608865.description: Neuropathic pain is a clinically challenging syndrome that is largely refractory to conventional therapies. It arises from lesions or diseases affecting somatosensory pathways, which trigger extensive neuroplastic and neuroimmune remodeling. Unlike nociceptive pain, which establishes a protective response to tissue injury, neuropathic pain arises from maladaptive signaling within the nervous system.

pmc-13396752.title: Laparoscopic Clipping of the Inferior Mesenteric Artery for the Treatment of Type II Endoleak Using Intra-operative Indocyanine Green Fluorescence Angiography
pmc-13396752.creator: Irene D Kikkert, Steven JG Leeuwerke, Harry GM Vaassen
pmc-13396752.description: IntroductionType II endoleaks (T2ELs) are a common finding after endovascular aortic repair (EVAR), often caused by retrograde flow from the inferior mesenteric artery (IMA). Although transarterial embolisation is standard, laparoscopic IMA ligation may provide a definitive alternative in selected cases. Indocyanine green fluorescence angiography (ICG-FA) adds real time vascular visualisation, helping the identification and confirmation of successful ligation.

pmc-13401072.title: Velopharyngeal Anatomy and Speech Production in Cleft Palate Surrounding Primary Palatoplasty: Protocol for a Prospective Observational Pilot Study
pmc-13401072.creator: Katelyn Kotlarek, Gregory Allen, Ilana Neuberger, Kate Bunton
pmc-13401072.description: BackgroundChildren with cleft palate often experience impaired speech due to atypical velopharyngeal anatomy following palate repair surgery. While surgical repair aims to restore the function of the palate, more than one-third of cases result in continued velopharyngeal insufficiency (VPI) and require reoperation, which can result in negative psychosocial impacts and financial burden.

pmc-13661861.title: Venetoclax combined with olverembatinib and prednisone as a frontline therapeutic strategy for Philadelphia chromosome-positive mixed-phenotype acute leukemia
pmc-13661861.creator: Xia Li, Yile Zhou, Xiangjie Lin, Hongyan Tong, Jie Jin, Huafeng Wang
pmc-13661861.description: Mixed-phenotype acute leukemia (MPAL) is a rare hematological malignancy with poor prognosis, for which there are currently no standardized therapeutic guidelines. Preclinical and clinical studies have shown that venetoclax and BCR::ABL1 tyrosine kinase inhibitors have synergistic effects on Philadelphia chromosome–positive (Ph +) leukemias.

uslaw-usc-t7-s496.title: 7 U.S.C. § 496 — Validity of other statutes dealing with same subject
uslaw-usc-t7-s496.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s496.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 20 (Dumping Or Destruction Of Interstate Produce). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. This chapter shall not abrogate nor nullify any other statute, whether State or Federal, dealing with the same subjects as this chapter, but it is intended that all such statutes shall remain in full force and effect, except insofar only as they are.
